rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for having fun or fooling around, and it can also mean casually playing an instrument as a hobby.

example.english: I play the guitar when I have free time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dak1 haan4 zau6 waan2 haa5 git3 taa1

rows.note: Use 戲 as the all-purpose colloquial noun for a stage work (39) or a theatrical performance (40).

example.english: This play is about a poor student chasing a dream.
example.traditional: 呢齣戲講一個窮學生追夢。
example.jyutping: ni1 ceot1 hei3 gong2 jat1 go3 kung4 hok6 saang1 zeoi1 mung6

rows.note: Use 比賽 for the course or progress of a competitive game or match.

example.english: The play was only decided in the final minute.
example.traditional: 場比賽打到最後一分鐘先分勝負。
example.jyutping: coeng4 bei2 coi3 daa2 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 fan1 zung1 sin1 fan1 sing1 fu6

rows.note: Use 打 for taking part in a sport or game, including competing against another team.

example.english: We play basketball tonight, so don't be late.
example.traditional: 今晚我哋打籃球，唔好遲到呀。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 daa2 laam4 kau4 m4 hou2 ci4 dou3 aa3

rows.note: Use 播 when a device plays recorded music or video, including a film or musical piece reproduced by a device.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zan6 bo3 tou3 hei3

rows.note: Use 玩樂 as the noun for amusement or recreational activity, especially for children, rather than the verb 玩.

example.english: During the holidays, children need time for play.
example.traditional: 放假嗰陣，小朋友都要有時間玩樂。
example.jyutping: fong3 gaa3 go2 zan6 siu2 pang4 jau5 dou1 jiu3 jau5 si4 gaan3 waan2 lok6

rows.note: Use 演出 for performing or presenting a character, play, or live show at a venue.

example.english: They'll play Snow White at the Cultural Centre tomorrow.
example.traditional: 佢哋聽日會喺文化中心演出白雪公主。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ting1 jat6 wui5 hai2 man4 faa3 zung1 sam1 jin2 ceot1 baak6 syut3 gung1 zyu2

rows.note: Use 播放掣 for the button that starts media playback.

example.english: Press the play button to start watching the video.
example.traditional: 撳播放掣就可以開始睇片喇。
example.jyutping: gam6 bo3 fong3 zai3 zau6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 tai2 pin2 laa3
